items.what: Exact event note templates produced when serializing Kraken events with a custom asset (e.g. 'Swap 1 Gold Bar in Kraken') — the instruction never names the required strings, but they match the repo's existing Kraken note templates with the custom asset's name substituted, which the minimal fix (using the asset name in serialization) would produce.
strings: Receive 1 Gold Bar as a result of a Kraken swap
Spend 1 Gold Bar as Kraken trading fee
Gain 1 Gold Bar from Kraken staking
Spend 1 Gold Bar as Kraken staking fee
Spend 1 Gold Bar as Kraken withdrawal fee

reason: The only unstated requirement is the exact note text for each event type/subtype, but these are the repo's existing Kraken note templates with the asset name (custom asset's name) interpolated, so the minimal fix of using the asset's name during serialization yields them mechanically. Imports like CustomAsset/DBCustomAssets are test scaffolding.
